title: Bus & Rail Transit Guide
subtitle: Nearest bus stands and railway stations matched to your first and final stops.

mdu-junction.name: Madurai Junction Railway Station
mdu-junction.directions: Leave via the East Gate towards West Veli Street for a 5-minute auto ride or 12-minute walk to Meenakshi Amman West Tower.
mdu-junction.platformHint: Prepaid auto kiosk sits just outside Platform 1 East Exit.

mdu-periyar-bus.name: Periyar Bus Stand
mdu-periyar-bus.directions: Central town hub next to Madurai Junction. Frequent town buses loop past West Tower, Thirumalai Nayakkar Mahal, and Teppakulam.
mdu-periyar-bus.platformHint: Bays 3–6 serve Teppakulam and Thiruparankundram routes.

mdu-mattuthavani-bus.name: Mattuthavani (MGR) Integrated Bus Terminus
mdu-mattuthavani-bus.directions: Main intercity coach terminus for Chennai, Trichy, and Rameswaram. Take town bus 77A or a 20-minute auto via Anna Nagar.
mdu-mattuthavani-bus.platformHint: Town buses depart from the outer front bay every 8–10 minutes.

kmu-bus-stand.name: Kumbakonam New Bus Stand
kmu-bus-stand.directions: Just 1.2 km east of Mahamaham Tank. Walk or hop on a 5-minute auto directly to Kasi Viswanathar and Sarangapani streets.
kmu-bus-stand.platformHint: Buses towards Swamimalai, Darasuram, and Thanjavur leave from Bays 1–4.

kmu-railway-station.name: Kumbakonam Railway Station
kmu-railway-station.directions: Direct rail connection from Chennai Egmore, Trichy, and Thanjavur. Station Road meets Mahamaham Tank in 1.1 km.
kmu-railway-station.platformHint: Local auto rank is directly outside the main portico.
